summary: Build consistency before speed. Focus on clean touches, recoveries and repeatable basic mechanics.

lessons.title: Ground control & power shots
lessons.focus: First touch, ball-carrying, shooting with purpose
steps: Free Play: carry the ball for 60 seconds without losing close control; repeat 5 times.
Shoot 20 balls from the top of the box: aim for corners, not the middle.
After every shot, land on all four wheels and turn back into play.
mistakes: Hitting every ball as hard as possible
Flipping through the ball and losing recovery
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League Gold rank ground control power shots tutorial

lessons.title: Basic aerial reads
lessons.focus: Read the arc, take off early, make one controlled touch
steps: Use an aerial training pack and call the landing point before takeoff.
Complete 10 simple aerial contacts with the nose pointed toward the target.
Prioritize a clean first touch over an immediate second touch.
mistakes: Chasing from directly underneath the ball
Boosting before aligning the car
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League beginner aerials tutorial Gold Platinum

lessons.title: Rotation & back-post defense
lessons.focus: Stop double commits and defend from the back post
steps: In 3v3, rotate out after your challenge instead of circling the ball.
When last back, approach the back post and face the play.
Play 3 casual matches tracking only double commits and defensive spacing.
mistakes: Following teammates into the same corner
Driving across the goal mouth toward the ball
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League back post rotation beginner tutorial

summary: Turn fundamentals into reliable habits: faster recoveries, deliberate challenges and controlled aerials.

lessons.title: Fast aerial foundations
lessons.focus: Efficient jump timing and boost path
steps: In Free Play, practice jump + tilt + second jump + boost as one fluid motion.
Make 15 aerial contacts while keeping forward momentum.
Compare takeoff timing from stationary and moving starts.
mistakes: Holding pitch back too long
Burning all boost before reaching the ball
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League fast aerial tutorial Platinum rank

lessons.title: Wall reads & clears
lessons.focus: Predict the bounce and clear to space
steps: Start with wall shots from both sides; read the rebound before jumping.
Make 10 defensive clears toward the side wall rather than center.
After each clear, recover to a useful position instead of watching the ball.
mistakes: Clearing the ball straight into the middle
Jumping before reading the bounce
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League wall reads defensive clears tutorial

lessons.title: Boost routes & challenge timing
steps: Play one match collecting small pads along your rotation path.
Challenge when you can touch the ball or force a predictable opponent touch.
After a lost challenge, rotate out and let the next teammate engage.
mistakes: Detouring for corner boost while play is dangerous
Challenging from a hopeless distance
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League boost management challenge timing tutorial

summary: Improve first-touch quality, recoveries and decision-making under pressure.

lessons.title: Air-roll control & recovery
lessons.focus: Orient the car and land with momentum
steps: In Free Play, jump and make small air-roll corrections toward a target wall.
Land on side walls and floors with wheels aligned to the surface.
Chain landing into a powerslide turn and immediate re-entry.
mistakes: Constant air roll without a target
Landing sideways and losing momentum
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League air roll control recovery tutorial Diamond

lessons.title: Dribble control & flick selection
lessons.focus: Carry the ball and choose a controlled flick
steps: Carry the ball at low speed for 30 seconds, repeat from both sides.
Practice front flicks and 45-degree flicks with a deliberate target.
Use a flick only when the defender commits or space is closing.
mistakes: Flicking immediately on every possession
Letting the ball roll too far ahead
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League dribbling flicks tutorial Diamond rank

lessons.title: Shadow defense & controlled challenges
lessons.focus: Delay the attack and force a poor touch
steps: In 1v1, shadow from a safe distance while matching the attacker's speed.
Keep your car between the ball and your net without diving early.
Challenge when the attacker loses close control or exposes the ball.
mistakes: Turning toward the ball too early
Giving the attacker a free cut around you
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League shadow defense controlled challenges tutorial

summary: Reduce unforced errors, build purposeful possession and convert pressure into team advantage.

lessons.title: Possession & outplay decisions
lessons.focus: First touch away from pressure and controlled 50s
steps: In Free Play, take the first touch away from the nearest imaginary defender.
Practice soft touches, cuts and low 50s rather than defaulting to a hard hit.
Review replays and mark every possession lost with no pressure applied.
mistakes: Giving away possession with panic clears
Forcing a dribble when a safe pass is available
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League Champion rank possession outplays tutorial

lessons.title: Backboard reads & second touches
lessons.focus: Turn rebounds into controlled shots or passes
steps: Use a backboard pack and predict the rebound before the first contact.
Aim the second touch at a corner or teammate lane, not just toward net.
Recover immediately after a missed read and cover the counter.
mistakes: Jumping without reading the rebound
Overcommitting as second man
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League backboard reads second touch tutorial Champion

lessons.title: 3v3 spacing & third-man discipline
lessons.focus: Maintain layered pressure and counterattack safety
steps: Review 3 replays and pause when your team has possession.
Check whether first, second and third man have distinct lanes.
As third man, advance only when the ball and teammates' recovery make it safe.
mistakes: Second and third man entering the same lane
Following the attack beyond a safe recovery line
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League 3v3 rotation Champion GC third man tutorial

summary: Refine speed, consistency and high-level reads. Train the decisions that separate clean pressure from reckless commits.

lessons.title: High-speed recoveries & wave dashes
lessons.focus: Preserve momentum through landings and transitions
steps: Practice landing nose-first, then chain a powerslide or wave dash into movement.
Run a 60-second route through walls, corners and pads without stopping.
Review failed recoveries and identify the landing angle that caused lost speed.
mistakes: Using mechanics when a simple landing is faster
Landing with no planned next route
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League Grand Champion recovery wave dash tutorial

lessons.title: Advanced first touch & air-dribble control
lessons.focus: Keep options open after the first contact
steps: Start from wall setup and vary the first touch: soft, lateral and low.
Maintain a reachable distance to the ball; use boost in short corrections.
End each attempt with a planned shot, pass or safe reset.
mistakes: Chasing the ball instead of matching its path
Using boost to correct a bad setup too late
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League advanced air dribble first touch Grand Champion tutorial

lessons.title: Replay review: challenge efficiency
lessons.focus: Measure whether challenges create useful outcomes
steps: Review one close loss and tag every challenge as win, neutral or lost.
For lost challenges, record distance, teammate cover and opponent control.
Choose one repeated mistake and train it for 10 minutes in Free Play.
mistakes: Judging a challenge only by whether you touched the ball
Ignoring the teammate who had to cover your miss
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League Grand Champion replay analysis challenge selection

summary: Optimize decision quality, adaptability and repeatability. Every drill should target a specific measurable weakness.

lessons.title: Micro-adjustments & high-level shooting
lessons.focus: Precise contact points at game speed
steps: Choose 3 shot types you miss under pressure and define a target corner for each.
Run 10 reps per shot type at full approach speed; count only on-target attempts.
Change one variable at a time: approach angle, first touch or contact point.
mistakes: Grinding reps without tracking accuracy
Changing multiple variables between attempts
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League SSL shooting consistency high level training

lessons.title: Adaptive 1v1 pressure & boost denial
lessons.focus: Force predictable touches and control resource lanes
steps: Track opponent boost and likely next touch during each possession.
Use low-commitment challenges to force a touch before taking space.
After winning possession, deny a resource lane only when the net remains covered.
mistakes: Overcommitting to boost denial
Respecting opponent space without applying pressure
lessons.videoSearch: Rocket League SSL 1v1 boost management pressure tutorial

lessons.title: Pro-level 3v3 review & role switching
lessons.focus: Adapt spacing to teammate speed and match state
steps: Review a high-level replay and map who is first, second and third man at each transition.
Note when a role swap is correct because a teammate has a better line to the ball.
Build a short checklist for your team's most frequent transition errors.
mistakes: Following fixed rotation rules when the play has changed
Ignoring score, time and opponent positioning
